name: Absinthia
look: a slender emerald-green fairy wrapped in cloudy louche mist with green wings, glowing eyes and a slotted silver spoon wand
entry: Artists in ancient cities sought out Absinthia for inspiration, though staring too long into its swirling emerald eyes causes vivid hallucinations.
how: Wild: uncommon, at night, in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
It learns Green Muse at level 17.
